description:
The runtime source, bootstrap registry, prelude alias, and Kernel.to_string/1 currently name the protocol `StringChars`. This is inconsistent with Elixir, the original ticket fz-5xp.15, its landing commit 39ab898411, the later runtime-library PR description, and repository-facing documentation, all of which call it `String.Chars`.

This is not a source-language limitation: ModuleName::parse_dotted is used by runtime bootstrap, dotted modules are documented and compiled, and compiler2 quoted-source coverage parses `defimpl String.Chars, for: Box`. No history records an intentional flattening.

Done means: bootstrap the runtime source as `String.Chars`; declare/implement/call the protocol under that name; update the prelude alias and docs/fixtures; and add a three-door behavior test that directly invokes `String.Chars.to_string/1` (in addition to Kernel.to_string/1), proving the public runtime namespace.
title: [BUG] Runtime protocol is flattened as StringChars instead of String.Chars
